correctness.rationale: Semigroup coefficient-difference identity and palindromicity reduce the nonzero-coefficient histogram to twice the cyclic semigroup-member gaps. The strictly increasing block thresholds and reflected insertion-time residue pattern prove a triangular exact count. Double-sum telescoping yields the formula, including the separate full-length arc. Direct coefficient generation on 3256 coprime pairs agrees, but is only supplementary. The standalone checker independently compares the critical insertion-tent count with direct cyclic arc counting for every coprime residue, distance and intermediate prefix at 2≤a≤27.
